releaseStatus: No data releases or assets published
policy: Distribute as much reference data as applicable terms allow. TripSit is included under its own terms, with full credit and backlink. Exclude explicit prohibitions, the WHO 2-FDCK candidate and permission-only content without written permission. Preserve scientific holds and unknowns separately from redistribution rights.

sources.name: PsychonautWiki contributors, structured API
sources.scope: Names, classes, explicit route dose and duration ranges.
sources.conditions: Retain source links, changes, field locators and unknown matched wiki revision. Do not include article media or infer specified forms.

sources.name: PsychonautWiki contributors, wiki drafts
sources.scope: Selected explicit draft ranges and confirmed identities.
sources.conditions: Retain share-alike, article revisions, draft/unreviewed state and changes. TripSit-origin material retains TripSit terms; Erowid-attributed material without permission is excluded.

sources.name: TripSit
sources.scope: Drug and combination data, including separately attributed range projections.
sources.conditions: Included in planned releases as separate removable files. Non-commercial use; credit TripSit and link https://combo.tripsit.me/ wherever shown. Include quick-overview/reference and individual-research notice. Preserve upstream information; describe packaging/index/unit changes. Commercial reuse and donations require their own review.

sources.name: Wikidata contributors
sources.scope: Structured entities, identifiers, corroborated aliases and reading links.
sources.conditions: Linked article text/media have separate rights. Preserve entity revisions, references and derivative lineage.

sources.name: ChEBI, EMBL-EBI and contributors
sources.scope: Selected names, formulae, structures and classes.
sources.conditions: Attribute ChEBI/EMBL-EBI/contributors; retain versions, hashes, changes and any third-party rights. Chemical class does not establish human dose.

sources.name: dose.wiki
sources.scope: Publisher contributions, compilation and normalization with underlying rights retained.
sources.conditions: Publish permitted fields under all applicable source terms. CC0 does not relicense TripSit, PsychonautWiki or permission-only material. Keep origin explicit; do not use numerical agreement as licence evidence.

sources.name: Labeler and National Library of Medicine, NIH, HHS
sources.scope: Original factual summaries with exact label/product/section/version and warning context.
sources.conditions: No blanket public-domain claim for manufacturer prose or media. Preserve labeler lineage, limitations and no endorsement. In-use company-submitted SPL does not itself establish FDA approval.

sources.name: FDA and original submitting sources
sources.scope: Eligible factual product/package identifiers, names, ingredients, strength, form and route.
sources.conditions: Exclude or separately clear marked third-party content, including GMDN. Preserve retrieval/revision and labeler lineage. NDC listing is not approval; labelled strength is not a dose recommendation.

sources.name: Base de données publique des médicaments
sources.licence: Etalab Open Licence, exact file/version applies
sources.conditions: Retain credited public authorities, source, update date and file-specific licence/conditions; do not imply official endorsement.

sources.name: PubChem and contributing sources
sources.conditions: Preserve contributor lineage and rights. PubChem aggregation does not relicense third-party works.

sources.name: Credited authors and publishers
sources.scope: Eligible factual claims or permitted extracts from primary literature.
sources.conditions: Use applicable CC0, CC BY or individually permitted works. Retain exact edition, locator, scope and rights. An index listing is not permission.

sources.name: Alexander and Ann Shulgin
sources.scope: Only permitted per-substance excerpts close to original wording.
sources.conditions: Retain exact Shulgin notices, source and changes. This exception does not grant reuse of Erowid dose charts. No payload is present.

sources.name: Wikipedia contributors
sources.conditions: Retain contributor attribution, exact article revision, source link, share-alike and changes. Reading links do not imply imported text.

sources.name: SAMHSA and credited authors
sources.scope: Permitted manual content with its original notices.
sources.conditions: Retain edition-specific rights and no-distribution-for-a-fee conditions where applicable. No blanket right over contributed works.

sources.name: Credited original providers
sources.scope: Other sources allowed by their actual applicable terms.
sources.conditions: Retain exact provenance, licence and applicability; publication permissions do not promote scientific review status. No data is included by this registry alone.

exclusions.name: WHO 2-FDCK quarantined candidate
exclusions.reason: Explicit exclusion. Quarantine remains private; no excerpts or adaptations exported.

exclusions.name: Permission-only material
providers: Erowid (except separately permitted Shulgin work excerpts)
exclusions.reason: Links only without an applicable written grant. Public availability, a mirror, another app or a permission request is not a grant.
